# Pulse Medical

> Pulse (Zuvio Technologies Private Limited) is a Bengaluru medical equipment company founded in 2025, headquartered in HSR Layout, Bengaluru, India. Pulse designs, quality-assures, supplies and services medical equipment made with Indian MSME manufacturing partners, across Critical Care, Renal Care, Cardiac Care, IVD Diagnostics, Surgical, Aesthetics, Rehabilitation and complete Hospital Setup. Backed by 3one4 Capital, Incubate Fund Asia and Stride Ventures.

Certifications stated on the site: ISO 13485, CE, CDSCO, MD13.

## Company
- [About Pulse](https://www.pulseio.in/about.html): Who Pulse is and how it works

## Product categories
- [Critical Care](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care.html): ICU ventilators, patient monitors, ECG machines, infusion and syringe pumps, anesthesia workstation
- [Renal Care](https://www.pulseio.in/renal-care.html): Dialysis equipment
- [Cardiac Care](https://www.pulseio.in/cardiac-care.html): Coronary stents, guidewires, inflation kits, manifolds and access kits
- [Surgical](https://www.pulseio.in/surgical.html)
- [Aesthetics](https://www.pulseio.in/aesthetics.html): Laser and aesthetic devices
- [Mobility](https://pulsemotion.in/): Pulse Motion electric wheelchairs (separate store)
- [Hospital Setup](https://www.pulseio.in/hospital-setup.html): ICU beds, OT tables and lights, trolleys, medical gas pipeline, modular OT
- [IVD Diagnostics](https://www.pulseio.in/ivd-diagnostics.html)

## Products
Every Pulse product page, by category. Each page has specifications, a buyer guide and FAQs.

### Critical Care
- [Pulse Anesthesia Workstation](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/anesthesia-workstation/): Pulse anesthesia workstation for adult and pediatric use: 20-1500 ml tidal volume, closed and semi-closed modes, CE. Get pricing and a demo.
- [Pulse ICU Ventilator](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/icu-ventilator/): Pulse ICU ventilator for neonatal, pediatric and adult care: turbine technology, 18.5-inch touchscreen, invasive and NIV. Get pricing and a demo.
- [Pulse 12-Channel ECG Machine](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/12-channel-ecg-machine/): Pulse 12-channel ECG machine with 1000-case internal storage, full keyboard, lithium battery and ECG data transfer to PC. Get pricing and a demo.
- [Pulse 3-Channel ECG Machine](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/3-channel-ecg-machine/): 3 channel 12-lead ECG machine with auto interpretation, 7-inch touchscreen and Li-ion battery. Compare price ranges and get a quote.
- [Pulse 6-Channel ECG Machine](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/6-channel-ecg-machine/): 6 channel 12-lead ECG machine with automatic interpretation, defibrillator protection, 7-inch touchscreen and Li-ion battery. See price ranges and get a quote.
- [Pulse Infusion Pump](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/infusion-pump/): Pulse infusion pump with 4.3-inch touchscreen, about 5-hour battery, 0.1-1500 ml/h flow and audible and visual alarms. Get pricing and a demo.
- [Pulse 5-Para Patient Monitor](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/5-para-patient-monitor/): 5 para monitor parameters: ECG (3/5 lead), SpO2, NIBP, pulse rate, respiration and temperature. 12.1" display, ST analysis, battery. Get the price.
- [Pulse 7-Para Patient Monitor](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/7-para-patient-monitor/): 7 parameter patient monitor with EtCO2 and cardiac output, NIBP for adult, paediatric and neonatal patients, 12.1" display and battery. Get the price.
- [Pulse Syringe Pump](https://www.pulseio.in/critical-care/syringe-pump/): Pulse Syringe Pump — 3.8" touch display, fits 5-50ml syringes, ±2% accuracy, 8+ hour battery life. Precision medication delivery for critical care.

### Renal Care

- [Pulse PD-Canova AV Fistula Needles — Safe and Reliable Vascular Access](https://www.pulseio.in/renal-care/pd-canova/): Pulse PD-Canova AV fistula needle twin sets in 15G, 16G and 17G with colour-coded wings, sterilised by gamma or ETO. Get pricing and a demo.
- [Pulse PD-Cath Haemodialysis Catheters](https://www.pulseio.in/renal-care/pd-cath/): Pulse PD-Cath haemodialysis catheters in single, double and triple lumen for acute, short-term access. MRI compatible. Get pricing and a demo.
- [Pulse PD-Linepro Blood Tubing Set](https://www.pulseio.in/renal-care/pd-linepro/): Pulse PD-Linepro blood tubing set with air removal chambers, kink-resistant tubing and a secure dialyser connection. Get pricing and a demo.
- [Pulse PDM-6000 Precision Haemodialysis System](https://www.pulseio.in/renal-care/pdm-6000/): Pulse PDM-6000 haemodialysis machine with +/-1% ultrafiltration accuracy, Kt/V monitoring and 30-minute battery backup. Get pricing and a demo.
- [Pulse PD-TP Transducer Protectors — Pressure Monitoring Safety](https://www.pulseio.in/renal-care/pd-tp/): Pulse PD-TP single-use transducer protector for dialysis pressure lines. Prevents contamination, keeps readings accurate. Get pricing and a demo.
